S: the mark put on the sub's own face (sidebar, banner, logo, styling)
F: the mark made into a flair members wear
O: the mark taken beyond the sub (stickers, the next artwork of the show, the source game's icon)
D: damage or an error in the mark kept as part of the emblem
C: the image corrected or bettered before it was adopted
I: the adoption shown carried out in the record
